facts.text: The University of Montana's Grizzly Promise provides a tuition-free education for in-state students from families earning less than $50,000 annually.

sources.title: UM Celebrates National First-Generation College Student Day
sources.quote: The Grizzly Promise, launched in 2022, provides in-state students a tuition-free education if they come from a family earning less than $50,000 annually.
